$comment: Who gets a key pressed on a streamed page (Tarayıcı, Masaüstü windows), as Chrome on macOS decides. `surface`: the browser's own shortcuts — the surface acts and the page gets nothing (an action the surface does not offer leaves the key to the page). `app`: Kokpit's menu keys — neither the surface nor the page, the menu bar runs them. Everything else goes to the page (Cmd+A / Z, Option and Cmd text navigation included; the engine applies the system's editing commands). Zoom (Cmd + − / = / 0) and copy / cut / paste have their own rules (view-prefs.ts, browser-input.ts). Combos: modifiers then a key; Mod = Cmd on macOS, Ctrl elsewhere; the key is a character (case ignored), a DOM key name or a physical key code.
